description:
FREE, no API key. Use when a fund manager (GP) wants to find LPs for a fund they are raising.
    Returns how many LP-type investors in DEALITHIC's network fit each LP type (pension,
    endowment, foundation, sovereign_wealth, fund_of_funds, family_office): counts only, no
    names or contacts. Counts are by LP type and are not yet scored against the strategy or
    fund size. target_fund_size_m is in USD millions. lp_types optionally narrows the types.
    If useful, offer request_lp_intro to book a demo where specific LPs are released.

fund_strategy.description: The fund's strategy in plain words, e.g. 'venture capital', 'real estate', 'private credit'.
fund_strategy.title: Fund Strategy

lp_types.description: Optional. Narrow to some LP types: pension, endowment, foundation, sovereign_wealth, fund_of_funds, family_office. Omit for all.
lp_types.title: Lp Types

target_fund_size_m.description: Target fund size in USD millions, e.g. 100 for $100M.
target_fund_size_m.title: Target Fund Size M

name: lp_match_preview
